_description: Layout library of the layout analysis: the alphabetic block (3 rows, base characters only) of each layout, by KeyboardEvent.code, imported on 2026-11-14 from the Oxeylyzer layout set (Apache-2.0 repository) and, for the classics it lacks, from the cmini collection (GPL-3.0 repository, user-submitted; licence of the data to review by the maintainer, see docs/audits/layout-analysers/report.md). « source » and « source_path » name the file each block comes from. The codegen completes each block with the US number row and the US Shift pairs (letters: upper case). The registry layouts (static/layouts/registry) and the reference QWERTY and AZERTY (layout_composer/reference_layouts.js) join the library at codegen with all their layers and dead keys, so they are not repeated here.
